title: Affordability and Cost
description: Affordability and Cost as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is a cost target for the installation set and agreed with the Sub-team?
Are the main cost drivers (bought-in equipment, materials, processes) identified?
Have lower-cost architecture options been considered and the choice recorded?
Is the cost of the installation within the Sub-team allocation?
Are part count and the number of unique parts minimised where practicable?
Are tooling and test equipment costs estimated and included?
Is the final cost estimate within target, or is any overrun recorded as an Issue?
Are standard and common parts used in preference to new made parts where they meet the need?
Are tolerances no tighter than function requires, to avoid unnecessary manufacturing cost?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
